top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards general Pd-catalysed C-N coupling with the cleanest two-person attribution on the slate, backed by isolated-intermediate and kinetic evidence and more than 25 years of independent, daily use in pharmaceutical, agrochemical and materials chemistry; the citation can name the C-N bond and ligand-design basis so it is not a restatement of the 2010 C-C coupling prize. P001 is second for its new modality and measured ternary-complex mechanism, but its trio cut excludes Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Kim and Ito, and no PROTAC is approved. P003 is mechanistically sound and bounded but is the experimental continuation of Marcus theory with others (Beratan, Onuchic, Dutton) excluded; P004 has a real design principle but contested priority and sits closer to pharmaceutical technology; no award is ranked last because P002 is a mature, well-attributed achievement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile (Stockholm University colleague of the committee secretary, but no link to any proposed laureate)
